authority: spec section 7 + implementation plan section 3 register (sample unit) and 7.2 item 3

estimator.form: self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS): R_hat = sum a_i l(x_i) / sum a_i; consistent, finite-sample biased (ratio bias O(1/n)); NOT unbiased and never described as exact
estimator.weight_bound: a_i = min{1/lambda_u, nu/m} with the clip provably inactive; implementations assert it never fires

sample_unit.definition: one confirmation sample = one tile-cropped (camera, frame) render unit; the loss l(x_i) is the photometric loss (L1 + lambda_ssim*DSSIM at training weights) averaged over the tile, so the windowed DSSIM is always evaluated on a full tile, never per pixel
sample_unit.tile: 128x128 pixels, candidate-targeted placement (the candidate's affected footprint) mixed with uniform-support tiles per pi_D below
sample_unit.nu: uniform over (training-camera, frame) pairs x tile grid positions
sample_unit.density_correction: tile weighting is uniform, so nu and m densities are computed per unit under the mixture below; no additional Jacobian
sample_unit.status: frozen (structural definition); tile size sensitivity is analyzed at M2 before any evidence-bearing comparison
sample_unit.smoke_note: the M0 smoke uses whole-frame units with lambda_u = 1.0, so the declared mixture is literally m = nu and weights are exactly 1 - the degenerate-valid SNIS case; disclosed, never evidence-bearing

mixture.pi_d: candidate-targeted rays/tiles (uniform over the candidate's affected (camera, frame) footprint)

lambda_u.criterion: smallest ESS-stable value in a preregistered sweep
lambda_u.freeze_point: before the first evidence-bearing B2 job

mixture.freeze_rule: pi_D and lambda_u frozen before ANY confirmation draw; enforced in code (FrozenSamplerParams.require_frozen)

acceptance_rule.form: accept iff Delta_E_hat + k*SE < 0, Delta_E_hat = paired SNIS render delta + exact closed-form deltas + transaction increment

k_se.criterion: false-event rate on dose-matched shifted lanes below the prereg_metrics floor

bootstrap.pairing: same resample indices for candidate and incumbent; per-replicate SNIS renormalization; SE = sample sd of paired replicate differences
bootstrap.degeneracy: <= 5 distinct units => reject; undefined SE => reject

crn.seed_derivation: index arithmetic on (base_seed, round, pass, rank); no content hashing

slot_grid.sizing: capacity = n_rounds x n_passes x candidate_cap slots, pre-partitioned at iteration 0 over the reserved pool
slot_grid.exhaustion: rank >= candidate_cap => candidate rejected and logged (never silent)
slot_grid.confirmation_rule: one confirmation per conflict component per pass; component rank = ascending min lineage id
slot_grid.reserved_exclusion: refit sampling excludes every reserved (camera, frame) unit (SlotGrid.reserved_units feeds the trainer sampler)
